Experience Luxury and Adventure Aboard MY Anemone

Inspired by Art Deco design, MY Anemone welcomes guests into a world of comfort and style, perfect for those seeking adventure and relaxation on the Red Sea. Built in 2022, this luxurious liveaboard offers an array of exciting activities, including dive safaris, kite safaris, and cruises, all while exploring some of the world’s most famous Red Sea sites.

MY Anemone spans five decks, featuring a dining area, a salon, and a bar on the upper deck, along with two spacious sun lounges complete with sunbeds, tables, and a jacuzzi. Guests can unwind in one of the 16 beautifully appointed air-conditioned rooms, each with en-suite facilities, ensuring a comfortable stay.

For relaxation and entertainment, the vessel offers two air-conditioned salons equipped with TVs, DVDs, free WiFi, and a sound system. Guests can enjoy excellent cuisine in the onboard restaurant, served by a friendly and well-trained crew dedicated to making every trip memorable.

Diving enthusiasts will appreciate the large dive deck, complete with a charging station and state-of-the-art equipment. MY Anemone is equipped with two Daewoo compressors, providing 320 liters each, and offers FREE NITROX (32% membrane) to enhance your diving experience. With two Zodiacs for easy access to dive sites and expert dive guides on board, every dive is a new adventure.

Available for weekly cruises departing from Hurghada and Port Ghalib, MY Anemone caters to both groups (full charters) and individual travelers. Whether you’re exploring vibrant coral reefs, kite surfing on the open sea, or simply relaxing in the sun, MY Anemone delivers an unforgettable Red Sea experience in style and luxury.
